canonical_statement: For every first-order language L, L-structure M, and L-substructure S of M, if every bounded formula with one witness variable and finitely many parameters from S that is realized by an element of M has a realizing witness in S, then S is an elementary substructure of M.
domain_and_universes: universes u v w; L : FirstOrder.Language.{v,w}; M : Type u; [L.Structure M]; S : L.Substructure M; Prop in universe 0
hypotheses: For every n, phi, x, and a, realization of phi by the parameters coerced from S and witness a implies existence of b : S realizing the same formula.
conclusion: S.IsElementary: every first-order formula has the same realization on tuples from S in S and M.
